autonomous_course.statement: 68 CAD fasteners/nuts are separate bodies, using with their Onshape mass properties.
Steering steering: kingpin targets interpolate the CAD-solved linkage table (41 rows over servo [-0.523, 0.523] rad).
CAD STL meshes are authored in the robot frame (m) and are visual only; collision uses primitive geoms.
IMU axes are aligned with the imu component frame at its origin.
Camera front_camera: pinhole MuJoCo camera at the lens, vertical FOV 33.0 deg (catalog); no lens distortion, motion blur or rolling shutter.
Steering linkage animated: horn on its servo-output joint, 2 tie rods on ball joints closed to the knuckle studs by equality constraints.
Open differential splits carrier torque equally (fixed tendon, coef 1/n); motor rotor inertia is reflected through ratio^2 onto the carrier; gear backlash is not modeled.
Each part is a separate MuJoCo body. Catalog or CAD convex-piece collisions, breakable constraints from real connections; mounts alone provide no retention.
Cables are MuJoCo elastic cables (composite type=cable, mujoco.elasticity.cable) in the robot's MuJoCo world: 19 cables for 38 wires, 37 spans, 10 mm segments, 56.4 g of wire.
Wires on one routed path form one loose bundle: mass and EI are summed (no composite action), contact radius from the optimal circle packing; every member reports the bundle surface clearance.

Plugin bend modulus E = EI / (pi r^4 / 4) from the catalog EI (estimates); twist G = E / (2 (1 + 0.45)); stress-free shape straight; Kelvin-Voigt damping tau = 2 ms (estimate) with a torsion-stability floor of 40 I_x / dt and an implicit bending stability floor of 4 pi^4 EI dt / (24 l).

Connector ends and cable ties clamp the bundle (span rooted in, or welded to, the pin's body); splices and harness-to-harness connectors are fixed to the chassis. The installed route is the initial shape (no added cut-stock bulge), sampled on-route at at most 10 mm arc spacing; it settles under gravity for 0.5 s before t = 0.

Cables collide with massless part collision geoms (CAD meshes split into convex pieces, else catalog primitives), not with each other; friction 0.5 against static parts (estimate), frictionless against moving parts (abrasion is not modeled; interference is reported); clearance to moving parts is the signed surface distance from MuJoCo contact data (listed up to 25 mm, only penetrations act).
Aerodynamic drag CdA = 0.04 m^2 (estimate), air density 1.184 kg/m^3; rolling resistance C_rr = 0.015 applied only for declared tire adapters; per-part rigid bodies with native joints.
ELRS 150 Hz = LoRa SF7 / 812.5 kHz; thermal noise -108.9 dBm (NF 6.0 dB), with interference -99.5 dBm.
Datasheet sensitivity -108.0 dBm defines SNR_req = 0.9 dB at 10 % PER (LoRa SF7 demod limit -7.5 dB; implied implementation loss 8.4 dB).
Gudmundson log-normal shadowing sigma 4.0 dB / 10.0 m for clutter outside the scene; downlink shares the uplink channel and shadowing (reciprocal).
FHSS: 80 channels from 2400.4 MHz, hop every 4 packets, pseudo-random sequence (seeded; not the ELRS hash).

Sionna RT ray tracing (2.2.0, Mitsuba variant llvm_ad_mono_polarized): specular reflection depth 3, refraction True, UTD wedge diffraction True, 200000 rays/source, no diffuse scattering (ground roughness not modelled).

Scene: ITU-R P.2040 'medium_dry_ground' ground plane (6000 m square), obstacles [cone_a: plastic], car body by material [metal: 44 parts; plastic: 81 parts] (material classes are estimates). Antennas: hw_dipole/hw_dipole, V-polarized, peak gains scaled to the catalog values (-0.30 dB total). Car antenna offset [0.175, 0.0, 0.192] m (cad).

Traced handset -> car antenna on a 0.25 m grid x 15 deg heading buckets with the car body posed per trace (exact blockage; near-field body scattering not modelled); first-segment exact extrapolation between traces; coherent sum at the FHSS hop frequency gives small-scale fading (no statistical fading model).
radio_environment.ground_permittivity=15 ignored without ground_conductivity; the ITU-R P.2040 'medium_dry_ground' material is used instead.
GPS local tangent plane: world +x east, +y north around 37.42750, -122.16970; errors = Gauss-Markov (60 s) + white noise sized to the datasheet CEP.

RTK rover: single/float/fixed solution model driven by the RTCM3 frames that reach UART2 intact (age of corrections, base position, baseline); RTK fixed CEP 0.01 m + 1 ppm (datasheet); float accuracy, fix hold age and convergence draw are estimates; wrong-fix events not modelled.

RTK correction link: SiK 915 MHz GFSK 64 kbit/s, 20 dBm, 50 hop channels, TDM window 37.1 ms (round 74.3 ms), no ECC/retransmission; datasheet sensitivity -105.0 dBm at BER 0.001; non-coherent FSK BER curve; thermal noise -119.9 dBm, interference -111.0 dBm (noise rise 9.4 dB); propagation Sionna RT.
RTK correction link propagation: ITU-R P.2040 fits extrapolated to 0.915 GHz (outside the tabulated range) for: medium_dry_ground (eps_r 15.13, sigma 0.0303 S/m), metal (eps_r 1.00, sigma 1e+07 S/m)

RTK correction link propagation: Sionna RT ray tracing (2.2.0, Mitsuba variant llvm_ad_mono_polarized): specular reflection depth 3, refraction True, UTD wedge diffraction True, 200000 rays/source, no diffuse scattering (ground roughness not modelled).

RTK correction link propagation: Scene: ITU-R P.2040 'medium_dry_ground' ground plane (6000 m square), obstacles [cone_a: plastic], car body by material [metal: 44 parts; plastic: 82 parts] (material classes are estimates). Antennas: hw_dipole/hw_dipole, V-polarized, peak gains scaled to the catalog values (-0.30 dB total). Car antenna offset [0.042, -0.008, 0.253] m (catalog).

RTK correction link propagation: Traced handset -> car antenna on a 0.6666666666666666 m grid x 15 deg heading buckets with the car body posed per trace (exact blockage; near-field body scattering not modelled); first-segment exact extrapolation between traces; coherent sum at the FHSS hop frequency gives small-scale fading (no statistical fading model).
RTK correction link propagation: radio_environment.ground_permittivity=15 ignored without ground_conductivity; the ITU-R P.2040 'medium_dry_ground' material is used instead.
RTK base and rover run 30 s before the scenario with the car parked at the start (warm receivers): rover in fixed at t = 0 (first fix at t = -18.4 s).
INA226 measures the current of the branch its shunt sits in (the HAT supply, W_Y_P_HAT); it does not see ESC/motor current.
Hall pulse phase assumes a magnet centred over the sensor at zero shaft angle; pulse width is the existing 50% duty approximation.
Hall encoder magnets ride on the spur shaft: encoder sees the differential carrier (mean of spin_rl, spin_rr) x 2.4727.

hat failsafe arbiter (ATtiny412, r3_kicad.arbiter): PI_ESC_PWM reaches ESC_PWM only while the heartbeat toggles; 60 ms without an edge -> 1500 us neutral from the next 20 ms frame; re-arm after 3 edges at neutral; boots in failsafe.
